  "part": {
    "name": "Double-sided scissor-linkage platform assembly (slotted-plate guided)",
    "description": "Assembly-like CAD model comprising two rectangular plates (upper and lower) separated in Y, connected by paired scissor links on both Z-sides. Link ends pivot on four corner pins; two of those corner interfaces are guided by elongated slots in the plates to allow relative motion (scissor expansion/contraction). Includes a central pivot spacer/pin set and four corner pivot pins with small edge blends.",
    "source_views": [
      "front",
      "back",
      "left",
      "right",
      "top",
      "bottom",
      "toprightiso"
    ],
    "symmetry_note": "Overall geometry is approximately symmetric about the mid-plane Z=0 (duplicated scissor linkages on +Z and -Z sides). Upper and lower plates are similar but mirrored/offset in Y; slot visibility differs by viewing side."
  },

part.name: Double-sided scissor-linkage platform assembly (slotted-plate guided)
part.description: Assembly-like CAD model comprising two rectangular plates (upper and lower) separated in Y, connected by paired scissor links on both Z-sides. Link ends pivot on four corner pins; two of those corner interfaces are guided by elongated slots in the plates to allow relative motion (scissor expansion/contraction). Includes a central pivot spacer/pin set and four corner pivot pins with small edge blends.
part.symmetry_note: Overall geometry is approximately symmetric about the mid-plane Z=0 (duplicated scissor linkages on +Z and -Z sides). Upper and lower plates are similar but mirrored/offset in Y; slot visibility differs by viewing side.

Section.name: Lower plate (base block with slot and pivot bore)
features included: Large rectangular prismatic plate/block
Through pivot bore at right corner (fixed pivot interface)
Elongated through-slot at left side/end region (guided pivot interface)
Outer edge blends/rounds (small fillets represented by cylinder/torus/sphere faces)
Section.function intent: Provide a rigid base platform and two types of linkage attachment: one fixed pivot and one guided (slotted) pivot to enable scissor motion.
Section.physical behavior: Acts primarily in bending and shear as a stiff support; slot walls react transverse loads from the guided pin while allowing in-slot translation; pivot bore reacts radial bearing load from pin and transfers it to the block volume.
Section.geometry: Rectangular block (length in X ~100) with thickness in Y ~12 and depth in Z ~45. Contains a left-side elongated slot (rounded ends) and a right-side cylindrical through bore. External edges are lightly blended.
Section.location: Lower (smaller Y) platform; spans full X and Z extents in the model.

Through pivot bore at right corner (fixed pivot interface)
Elongated through-slot at left side/end region (guided pivot interface)

Section.function intent: Provide the rigid top platform and the complementary fixed and guided pivot interfaces for the scissor linkage to raise/lower the upper platform relative to the lower.
Section.physical behavior: Acts as a rigid body under platform loading; slot walls carry lateral reaction forces while permitting translation of a guided pin; pivot bore carries bearing loads and transmits them into the block.
Section.geometry: Rectangular block similar to the lower plate, offset upward in Y. Includes a left elongated slot and right cylindrical bore. External edges include small blends.
Section.location: Upper (larger Y) platform; spans full X and Z extents in the model.

Section.name: Right-side scissor linkage (plates and pivot pads on +Z side)
features included: Two crossing link plates (scissor arms) located on +Z side
Four end pivot interfaces (two fixed, two guided in slots depending on plate/side)
Central pivot hole/boss region
Local circular pads/bosses at link ends (bearing land around pin holes)
Section.function intent: Provide one of the two parallel scissor mechanisms that transmits load between upper and lower plates and defines their relative motion path.
Section.physical behavior: Links act as tension/compression members with bending due to offset loads; end holes carry bearing loads from pins; central pivot carries shear and bearing; crossing geometry converts relative horizontal pin motion (in slots) into vertical separation of plates.
Section.geometry: Two thin plates with widened circular ends (pads) and a central widened region, each with through-holes at ends and at center. Located on the +Z side as a mirrored set to the -Z linkage.
Section.location: On the +Z face of the assembly, spanning between upper and lower plates.

Section.name: Left-side scissor linkage (plates and pivot pads on -Z side)
features included: Two crossing link plates (scissor arms) located on -Z side
Four end pivot interfaces (two fixed, two guided in slots depending on plate/side)
Central pivot hole/boss region
Local circular pads/bosses at link ends (bearing land around pin holes)
Section.function intent: Provide the second parallel scissor mechanism to stabilize the platforms and share load with the right-side linkage.
Section.physical behavior: Mirrors right-side behavior: link plates act in tension/compression with some bending; end holes and central hole carry bearing/shear; overall provides lateral stability and load sharing across Z.
Section.geometry: Two thin plates with widened circular ends and a central widened region, each with through-holes at ends and center, located on the -Z side.
Section.location: On the -Z face of the assembly, mirrored to the +Z linkage.

Section.name: Corner pivot pins (4x vertical pins)
features included: Four cylindrical pivot pins located at the four corner pivot points
Pin end faces (caps) at both Z extremes
Small edge rounds/chamfers represented by torus faces near pin ends
Section.function intent: Provide revolute joints for the linkage ends and platform interfaces; in slotted locations they also act as sliders within the slot.
Section.physical behavior: Pins carry shear and bearing loads; provide rotation at link-hole interfaces and, where engaged with slots, allow translation along slot direction while reacting transverse forces through slot walls.
Section.geometry: Four circular cylinders (radius ~2.4) extending across the full depth (Z) with flat end faces and small blended edge transitions.

features included: Central cylindrical spacer/pin (two instances: +Z and -Z side)

Provides stand-off/clearance between crossing link plates
Section.function intent: Provide the scissor crossover pivot, maintain spacing/clearance between link plates, and carry shear through the central revolute joint.
Section.physical behavior: Carries joint shear and bearing loads through its cylindrical surface; end faces act as thrust/spacing references controlling link stack-up and preventing rubbing between links.
